title: Fact or manipulation?
instruction: A claim you can check, or a pull at your emotions? Decide!

items.why: You can check the result on the league's website or in the highlights.
It pushes on hurry and fear. Nothing specific that could be checked.
It can be measured. It holds exactly at sea level.
It appeals to the crowd instead of to evidence.

items.text: “The study was published in the journal Nature in 2023”
items.why: The journal and the year are details you can look up.

items.text: “Wake up, they're hiding this from you!”
items.why: It stirs up a feeling of conspiracy and gives you nothing to check.

items.text: “The train leaves the main station at 8:15”
items.why: You can check it in the timetable.
It attacks you instead of making an argument. It wants you to be ashamed to disagree.

debrief: A fact can be checked: a result, a time, a source. Manipulation pushes on emotions and hurry and avoids being checked. When something urges you to act right now, slow down.
